ticket.description: Calls to a backend system started timing out at about 2pm UTC for every request. No release happened.

runbooks.title: Timeouts when calling a backend
runbooks.content: Possible causes: the backend is down or overloaded, a firewall or routing change, a wrong address resolved for the backend, network congestion. Check where the connection attempts go and whether the backend itself is healthy.

runbooks.title: General HTTP 5xx investigation checklist
runbooks.content: 1. Find the first error in the logs and note the time. 2. Check recent deploys of the affected service near that time. 3. Check dependencies (database, payment gateway, cache). 4. Compare error rate before and after the change.

runbooks.title: Rotating the CDN signing key
runbooks.content: Steps to rotate the CDN signing key every quarter: generate a new key, publish it, wait for propagation, retire the old key.

ground_truth.root_cause: The DNS record for warehouse.internal was changed from 10.4.1.8 to 10.8.8.8 by a terraform apply, so reporting-service connects to the wrong address and times out
